question.text: Under Rule 8 of SCRR, a person can succeed to the established business of a deceased or retiring member if the member is their:

answer.text: Father, uncle, brother, or any other close relative as per the governing body's opinion
Any unrelated person approved by SEBI

explanation.text: The Logic: Rule 8 allows succession to the business of a deceased or retiring member who is the person's father, uncle, brother, or any other person who is, in the opinion of the governing body, a close relative. The Trap: The list is not limited to father or brother; it includes uncle and any other close relative as determined by the governing body. Note: The governing body's opinion is the deciding lens for whether someone qualifies as a "close relative" for succession.
